title: Möbius invariance of the Ramsey property for finite spherical sets
abstract: Theorem C: for finitely many distinct points a of the unit sphere of R^d and any L in O(1,d) (L^T S L = S with S = diag(-1, 1, ..., 1)), the configuration a is Euclidean Ramsey if and only if its image under the Möbius map phi_L is Euclidean Ramsey. There is no affine-spanning hypothesis. Ramsey is OpenAI's definition from result 172 (for every r >= 2 there is D such that every r-colouring of R^D contains a monochromatic congruent copy). Corollaries, also proved: every Möbius image of a finite set of distinct unit-sphere points with real algebraic coordinates is Ramsey; and for distinct rationals t_i and arbitrary reals k != 0 and c, the circle points circ(k t_i) and circ(t_i + c) form Ramsey sets, where circ is the stereographic chart of the unit circle. The proof builds on OpenAI's complete Lean proof of the classification of finite Euclidean Ramsey configurations (openai/math fd4aeeb2, result 172), whose 28 files are included with header-only changes for the Lean module system. The Lorentz matrix transports OpenAI's real tensor criterion; OpenAI's descent and sufficiency conclude. All theorems depend on propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound only.
